independence.basis: All 40 actual original RGBA sources, stored skin/hair/reference masks and actual v4 tints inspected at native and 10x nearest-neighbour size. Pixel values used to record visually located witnesses. V1 failures were rechecked explicitly. No source-envelope labels or algorithm code used as semantic ground truth.

scope.generalization: Sample findings only; no claim for the other 300 frames or all looks.

interpretation: All previously confirmed contamination witnesses are repaired at their exact coordinates. That does not turn nine unresolved source boundaries into a contamination PASS.
No new confirmed cloth/prop contamination was established in this bounded v2 recheck; contamination remains PASS31/UNCERTAIN9. No confirmed frozen S/idle defect requiring a mask change was raised.

Original source anatomy demonstrates six incomplete hair references, including missing dark side-lock ink and interior colored hair highlights. Thirty-four further references remain uncertified at occluded or mixed face/hair/prop boundaries. A color rule and numeric ratio do not prove a complete silhouette.
All 40 formal hair coverage checks remain NOT_VERIFIABLE, including numeric passes. Reference failures in frozen S/idle frames are denominator findings, not authorization to alter frozen masks/bakes.

The strict idle-S metrics still fail adult_F face coverage (0.5357142857142857) and child_M second forearm coverage (0.5416666666666666). These are preserved existing metrics, not new defects discovered by v2 visual inspection, and no waiver is inferred.

Adult_F E/walk_a and child_M E/carry still have obvious unmasked arm regions. Other non-idle frames retain smaller skin omissions. These observations are recorded without inventing a 100% all-pose coverage requirement.
PASS for contamination means no clear spill observed in this sample at the inspected scales. It does not establish owner approval, all-frame correctness, or hair-reference validity.
Alpha and supplied-outline RGBA preservation are independent mechanical results. The supplied outline itself was not semantically certified as complete.
The v1 review remains unchanged and this review applies only to the exact v2 candidate hashes. Any later revision requires a new review record.
source_envelope_hash_limitation: Per-envelope digests copied from immutable audit40; exact source-report file bytes were rehashed and matched. No claim of independently reconstructing the envelope serialization.
